## Independent acceptance

I independently reviewed PR #251 against the USER-approved v3 residual-closure amendment and current authoritative main.

Current main remains `f344552fe58db26438a4f0b2c9abb1806e6a99d9`, exactly the amendment execution base. PR #251 is open, non-draft and mergeable at reviewed head `360fc827e2b6146f0961442b53e3eb172a8aa4e8`. No main drift or execution-base refresh was observed.

The durable remaining order is exactly:

`PT-6R1 -> PT-6R2 -> PT-7 -> PT-8A -> PT-8B -> PT-9`.

- PT-6R2 audits actual SDK/provider/retry/job boundaries and stops at `PROVIDER_OR_JOB_LATENCY_BUDGET_DECISION` if a numeric budget/product tradeoff is required.
- PT-7 audits the demonstrated production Docker-build/required-check gaps without introducing verifier/workflow breadth for appearance.

- PT-8B requires independent PT-8A acceptance and exact source/image/tag/digest/runtime/corpus binding.
- PT-9 requires independent PT-8B acceptance and an explicit USER destructive checkpoint.

The PT-8A rationale is preserved: broad-v4 run `37419983898` exposed positive semantic/false-green defects; PR #237 changed production generated-resource evidence closure; PR #238 aligned the evaluator with production orchestration; no complete final live broad-v4 remeasurement established acceptance after those corrections.
